blocks.en: The following lemma tells us why we need to consider unbounded operators only when we study infinite-dimensional spaces.
blocks.zh: 以下引理说明了为什么只有在研究无穷维空间时才需要考察无界算子.

blocks.en: All operators with finite-dimensional domain $\mathcal{D}(A)$ are bounded.
blocks.zh: 所有定义域 $\mathcal{D}(A)$ 为有限维的算子都有界.
blocks.label: lem:finite-dimensional-domain-operators-bounded

blocks.en: The following theorem states we can extend any bounded operator to all of $X$ without changing its norm.
blocks.zh: 以下定理断言, 可以将任意有界算子延拓到整个 $X$, 而不改变其范数.

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: Every bounded operator $(\mathcal{D}(A),A)$ can be extended to all of $X$ without changing its norm; i.e., there exists a bounded operator $(\mathcal{D}(\widetilde A),\widetilde A)$ that extends $A$ and such that $\mathcal{D}(\widetilde A)=X$ and $\|\widetilde A\|=\|A\|$.
blocks.zh: 每个有界算子 $(\mathcal{D}(A),A)$ 都可以在不改变其范数的情况下延拓到整个 $X$; 即存在延拓 $A$ 的有界算子 $(\mathcal{D}(\widetilde A),\widetilde A)$, 使 $\mathcal{D}(\widetilde A)=X$ 且 $\|\widetilde A\|=\|A\|$.
blocks.label: thm:bounded-operator-norm-preserving-extension

blocks.en:
Because of Theorem~\ref{thm:bounded-operator-norm-preserving-extension}, the domain of a bounded operator is almost always assumed to be the entire space $X$.

In Chapter~\ref{chap:function-spaces}, we saw that $\mathcal{L}(X,Y)$, equipped with the operator norm, is a Banach space. In the following, we shall sometimes also be interested in pointwise convergence rather than norm convergence. We make the following definition.
blocks.zh:
由于 Theorem~\ref{thm:bounded-operator-norm-preserving-extension}, 几乎总是假设有界算子的定义域为整个空间 $X$.

在 Chapter~\ref{chap:function-spaces} 中看到, 配备算子范数的 $\mathcal{L}(X,Y)$ 为 Banach 空间. 下文有时也关注逐点收敛, 而不是范数收敛. 作如下定义.

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: We say that $A_n\in\mathcal{L}(X,Y)$ \textbf{converges strongly} to $A\in\mathcal{L}(X,Y)$ if $A_nx\to Ax$ for every $x\in X$.
blocks.zh: 若对每个 $x\in X$, 都有 $A_nx\to Ax$, 则称 $A_n\in\mathcal{L}(X,Y)$ \textbf{强收敛}到 $A\in\mathcal{L}(X,Y)$.
blocks.label: def:operator-strong-convergence

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: For example, let $X=Y=\ell^2$ and let $A_n$ be the operator which truncates a sequence after $n$ terms. Let $A_n$ converges strongly to the identity, but not in the sense of the operator norm.
blocks.zh: 例如, 设 $X=Y=\ell^2$, $A_n$ 为在 $n$ 项之后截断序列的算子. 则 $A_n$ 强收敛到恒等算子, 但不在算子范数意义下收敛.
